fields.summary: Barbell basics, coached. Squat, press and deadlift with a plan that adds weight week by week.
fields.description:
Barbell basics, coached. Squat, press and deadlift with a plan that adds weight week by week.

Every class starts with a coached warm-up and ends with a cool-down. The coach scales each part to you: lighter, shorter or slower is always an option, and so is more.

New? Come ten minutes early and say hello. We will show you round and set you up.

/privacy.title: Privacy
/privacy.content:
Common Ground keeps the details you send through our forms to reply to you and to book your classes. We do not sell them or share them with anyone else.

What we keep

Your name, email, phone number and the notes you choose to add.

How long

Two years after your last visit, then we delete them. Ask us and we will delete them sooner.

/terms.title: Terms
/terms.content:
Memberships run month to month unless a plan says otherwise. Cancel any time with a month's notice.

Classes

Book or turn up; if a class is full the coach will find you a spot in the next one.
